tokens.name: navy
tokens.usage: Sampled from the Bahria logo. Document title, section headings, table header fill, title band. White text on navy passes 4.5:1.

tokens.name: sky
tokens.usage: Sampled from the logo ring. Fill of the student details table and the exercise heading band. Text on sky is ink, never white.

tokens.name: sky-soft
tokens.usage: Tint of sky. Ground of code and output blocks and alternate table rows. Text on it is ink.

tokens.name: gold
tokens.usage: Sampled from the logo wreath. The 4px rule under the title and under each exercise heading. Decoration only, never text.

tokens.name: flame
tokens.usage: Sampled from the logo torch. One small mark at most per page, such as the square before the Result label. Decoration only, never text on paper.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Sampled from the logo lettering. All body text and code on paper, sky and sky-soft.

tokens.name: muted
tokens.usage: Captions, the date line and page footer on paper. Passes 4.5:1 on paper.

tokens.name: rule
tokens.usage: Table borders and the hairline around code blocks.

tokens.name: paper
tokens.usage: Page ground. Also the text colour on navy fills.

styles.name: doc-title
styles.sample: Lab 5: Greedy and A* Search Algorithm
styles.usage: The assignment title, once per document, in navy.

styles.name: section-heading
styles.usage: One per exercise or question, in navy with a gold rule under it.

styles.name: sub-heading
styles.usage: Code and Output headings inside an exercise, in navy.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: The search reaches the goal through S, A, B, F and G.
styles.usage: Task, Result and explanation paragraphs, table cells.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Table header cells and the Task and Result labels, uppercase.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Date line, course line and page footer, in muted.

styles.name: code
styles.usage: Python code and program output, in ink on sky-soft.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Thickness of the gold rule; gap between a label and its text.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Table cell padding; gap between a heading and its gold rule.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Padding inside code blocks; gap between paragraphs and blocks.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Gap above each exercise heading; gap between the header and the first exercise.

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: Page margin on screen. In Word or PDF use 1 inch margins.

tokens.name: radius-none
tokens.usage: Tables, bands and rules. The theme is square, like a printed lab sheet.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Reserved for screenshots or figures placed in a report.
